purpose: Determine whether the frozen Stage56 coordinate failure reflects invalid PPARD structures or a systematic author-residue-numbering mismatch.

amendment_contract.permitted_change: replace same-author-number residue correspondence with deterministic global PPARD sequence correspondence before coordinate alignment
amendment_contract.sequence_alignment: global amino-acid alignment; match 2, mismatch -1, gap-open -10, gap-extend -0.5; deterministic first optimal alignment
unchanged_thresholds: minimum matched C-alpha count 230 after correspondence
maximum aligned global C-alpha RMSD 3.5 A
qualifying ligand within 6.0 A of the reference ligand

interpretation_boundary: Stage56a is a technical adjudication of author residue numbering after a pre-docking coordinate failure. It may authorize only a sequence-correspondence amendment with every biological and geometric threshold unchanged; it cannot authorize docking, enrichment claims, protected-data access, QUBO fitting, or quantum hardware.
